name: Ultimate Powers Tycoon
desc:
Forge your path to greatness by unlocking legendary powers and building your ultimate tycoon empire 🏗️. Gear up, battle fierce enemies ⚔️, conquer the game, and Become the strongest and richest💸to be the best in the server!

🔥 Choose your element, master its abilities, and rise to the top! Whether you're defending your base or raiding others, every move counts. Can you become the strongest in the server?

👍 Enjoying the game? Smash that thumbs-up to help us

❓FAQ & Tips:
💾 Progress saves in this game
🔄Rebirth in order to increase your stat points
🔒 Elements lock if two people use the same ones.
🌀 You can steal other peoples abilities from their tycoon
